jobs.title: Creative Strategist (M/W/D)
jobs.description:
Deine Mission
Wir organisieren echte Abenteuer-Touren abseits vom Massentourismus — für Menschen, die keinen Bock auf Pauschalreisen und Touristenmassen haben, sondern Gleichgesinnte, neue Erfahrungen und Orte suchen, an die sonst kaum jemand geht.

Wir suchen einen Creative Strategist, der den Kern unseres In-House-Performance-Marketings bildet und unsere Creative Factory verantwortet.
Diese Creative Factory beginnt beim strategischen Ansatz: Welche Zielgruppe sprechen wir an? Welcher Angle ist relevant? Welche Hook erzeugt Aufmerksamkeit? Welche Botschaft baut Vertrauen auf? Und wie übersetzen wir das in Creatives, die auf Meta, Google und im E-Mail-Marketing funktionieren?
Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern zusammen, bist aber in der operativen Umsetzung der verantwortliche Owner. Du entwickelst Angles, Hooks, Botschaften und Briefings und steuerst anschließend die Umsetzung mit Video-Editoren, Grafikern, Freelancern oder Agenturen, damit daraus performante Creatives für unsere Kanäle entstehen.

DEINE AUFGABEN
Creative Strategy (weiter)entwickeln: Aus Zielgruppe, Angebot, Markt, Teilnehmerfeedback und Performance-Daten klare Creative-Hypothesen ableiten.
Angles, Hooks und Botschaften konzipieren: Du verstehst was von Awareness Stages und bist in der Lage das Messaging logisch anhand von iterativen Testing-Routen aufzubauen.
Creatives briefen: Klare Briefings und Skripte für Reels, UGC-Ads, Founder-Ads, Testimonials, Statics, Motion Designs und Landingpage-Elemente schreiben.
Wöchentliche Creative-Produktion steuern: Mit Video-Editoren, Grafikern, Creators, Freelancern oder Agenturen zusammenarbeiten und sicherstellen, dass aus Ideen testbare Meta-Creatives werden.
Creative Testing & Learnings verantworten: Tests strukturieren, Ergebnisse auswerten, Muster erkennen und daraus neue Iterationen, Varianten und Creative-Angles ableiten.

Das solltest du mitbringen:
Mind. 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit eigenverantwortlicher Erstellung Performance Creatives für Meta aber gerne auch Google: Du hast schon den Erstellung von Creatives am Fließband angeleitet.
Sicheres Verständnis von Performance-KPIs: Du kannst Kennzahlen wie CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS, Conversion Rate und Creative Fatigue lesen und daraus sinnvolle Creative-Learnings ableiten.
Starkes Gespür für Hooks und Angles: Du kannst verstehst unsere Brand und die Bedürfnisse unserer Teilnehmer.
Erfahrung im Briefing und in der Creative-Produktion: Du kannst Video-Editoren, Grafikern, Creators, Freelancern oder Agenturen klare Briefings geben und Ideen in testbare Creatives übersetzen.

Was wir dir bieten
Mission: Du arbeitest an einem ganz klaren Ziel: Menschen zu Abenteurern zu machen!
Abenteuer! Wir haben ein paar Kriterien dafür, aber die Chancen stehen gut, dass du dich bald in der Wüste oder an einem anderen Ort in der Welt wiederfinden wirst!
Unser Büro mit Wohnzimmer-Atmosphäre liegt direkt am Brüsseler Platz im Herzen von Köln.
Homeoffice: Arbeiten vom Homeoffice ist natürlich möglich, wobei wir dich lieber im Büro haben.
Perfomance: Wir sind ein kleines Startup mit flachen Hierarchien, hochmotivierten Kollegen, die wirklich etwas bewegen wollen.
Dein Impact: Du wirst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit sehen, weil du nicht nur ein kleines Rädchen im Großen System bist.
Verpflegung: Wir versorgen dich mit Kaffee und kalten Getränken, Obst etc im Büro.

You're a producer with creative instinct and point of view. You understand what makes great content, appreciate the craft behind it, and know how to bring ambitious creative ideas to life.

Create work with global impact.

Brief and direct: brief designers, directors, agencies and creators, push the work until it earns its place
Build the brand platform: grow the creative system so it scales consistently across channels and corridors, using AI tools to move through concept rounds faster
Measure what lands: track reach, engagement and brand lift, iterate fast and feed what you learn back into the work

Your experience

4 or more years at a top creative agency as a copywriter, art director or creative, you know what world-class craft actually takes
2 or more years building or relaunching a brand at a startup or scale-up, shipping with small teams and tight budgets
Portfolio that shows at least 1 strong agency campaign and 1 brand you built or rebuilt in-house, with your specific role on each made clear

Fintech, remittance or regulated-category experience, including financial promotions
Rebrand experience end to end: strategy, identity and launch
Directing or writing shoots and brand films, or long-form editorial work

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. Founded in 2018, we started as MANUAL, focusing on hair loss, weight loss and men’s health. As we grew, we realised we could help more people. In 2025, we became Voy and expanded into more areas of health, including female hair loss, testosterone, menopause, dermatology and diagnostics with Do Health.

Today, Voy has around 750,000 active customers and has treated more than 2 million people since we began. We work across the UK, Germany, Brazil and India to make a new future of healthcare a reality. We’re approaching $1bn in ARR and have grown more than 100% year on year, every year since inception. At Voy, we let the evidence do the talking. In a published study of over 100,000 people, those who reached 12 months in the Voy programme and stayed engaged lost up to 24% of their body weight.

Our vision is simple: to make 100 years of healthy living within reach for everybody. Our mission is to bring quality care to everyone, at scale.

As our AI Creative Technologist, you drive the visual world of our brands across our digital channels (web, CRM and paid social), including product and lifestyle imagery for both Derma and Weight Loss. You also design and build the AI-native production pipelines that let us produce on-brand work at the speed our growth needs. You are a hybrid of creative and engineer: someone with strong visual taste and judgment who uses AI to explore more and ship faster, and who builds pipelines rather than just writing prompts, without letting the work look generic.

This is a new role for the company. As you automate repetitive production work, you will help us rethink how responsibilities are shared across the team.

You will work closely with Brand, Performance Marketing and CRM, with a clear say on quality and compliance for AI-assisted work. Success means faster concept-to-launch, more assets from fewer hours, and consistently on-brand quality.

What You'll Be Doing

Digital Brand Systems: Build and maintain the expression of the FORMEL SKIN and VOY brands: components, templates, imagery and motion principles that carry our core identity into all digital channels, and keep both brands distinct, premium and consistent.
AI-Native Production Pipelines & Workflows: Design, document and maintain repeatable workflows for imagery, copy variants, resizing, versioning and localisation across channels and markets. This includes style references, prompt libraries, templates and, where it makes sense, brand-conditioned models, so machines and teammates can execute against our guidelines.
Build end-to-end pipelines (not just prompts) that connect tools such as Claude and Figma, so one approved campaign creative can be reproduced in many variants, formats and languages. Extend these pipelines to AI video and motion content, avoiding "AI slop".
Quality Standards & Review: Define the quality bar and review standards for digital and AI-generated creative (including typography and packaging details, which AI often gets wrong), and review AI, agency and non-designer work against it, including whether agency work is compliant. Partner with the brand and creative team on campaign direction, while you own the standards and guardrails for digital and AI-assisted production.
Concept to Launch, Fast: Turn campaign and launch concepts, including the creative team's, into launch-ready digital assets quickly, with many directions and variants to test across paid social, CRM and web.
Enablement: Turn your workflows into tools and templates that can be used by the whole marketing team (not only Brand), so people become more self-sufficient, and train the team to use them.
Creative Testing & Performance: Use campaign data and customer insight to decide which directions to push, refine or retire, working closely with the Paid team to produce many variants and learn from them. Build lightweight testing tools (concept scoring, variant testing, dashboards) to judge whether creatives work before and after launch.
Tool Scouting: Track the AI creative stack, test new tools critically and recommend what we adopt or skip.
Compliance & Responsible Use: Work with Legal and Regulatory teams to define where AI may be used and where we are limited in using it, and build those rules into the workflows. Act as the internal owner of these rules and keep them up to date as regulation changes.

What You Need To Shine

5+ years of professional experience working in agencies, AI content/video platforms or in-house creative teams, preferably with a background in creative technology or design systems, ideally in lifestyle consumer, beauty, e-commerce or health brands, with a portfolio that shows premium craft and strong taste. The work has to look good as design, not just "good for AI".
Deep fundamentals in typography, colour, composition, photography and imagery, layout and brand systems, and the ability to explain creative decisions.
Expert-level proficiency in AI image generation, with production-quality work to show, including prompting, reference and image-to-image workflows, editing and upscaling, ideally from replacing traditional photo or content production with AI-generated imagery. Fluency across the wider AI stack (video, LLMs, automation) and an honest view of each tool's limits, with no loyalty to a single one.
Proven ability to architect production pipelines: connecting several tools and models into reliable, repeatable systems (for example node-based or automation platforms, scripting or APIs) rather than relying on prompting alone.
A clear method for keeping AI output on-brand beyond "writing good prompts", and the judgment to know when not to use AI.
Expert knowledge of Figma and Photoshop, plus AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney and Higgs Field (or similar), and openness to tools we don't use yet. You understand motion and video well enough to build pipelines that deliver high-quality results; hands-on motion production or video-editing is not required.
A bias for shipping: you work fast, test ideas with data and learn from what performs. You can build simple testing tools with AI coding assistants or no-code platforms and read the results without over-trusting them.
You are autonomous and self-driven, and comfortable building a brand-new role in a fast-moving marketing setup and changing how the team works.
Fluent English; German is a plus.

Nice to have

Experience with fine-tuning or conditioning image models (for example LoRAs) or building lightweight internal creative tools
Experience in healthcare, telehealth, pharma or another regulated advertising environment

Why work with us?

Real ownership: You shape how two growing health brands use AI creatively, owning digital production and quality.
Tools that match the ambition: The AI creative tools and hardware you need, plus a budget to test new ones.
Benefits designed to support you: 28 days of vacation, a NAVIT or Urban Sports Club membership, employee discounts on our products, a professional development budget, flexible working hours, a hybrid setup in Berlin, and the option to work remotely for up to four weeks within the EU.
A team that builds together: An international team that cares about what it builds, with regular company events, a team event budget and referral bonuses.

We’ve supported over 2 million people globally, and they don’t all look, live or think the same. Neither do we. People with different experiences notice different problems and find better answers, so we make sure everyone at Voy feels respected, heard and able to grow their career here. If you need any adjustments or extra support during the hiring process, just let us know when you apply.

Want to know what it’s really like to work at Voy? Follow us on LinkedIn. To learn more about our products, experts and how we change lives, visit joinvoy.com.
